pages.text: $(#789aff)【Non-physical Resistance】$()$(br2)Takes L% (max 30%) less non-physical damage (magic, fire, explosions...).$(br2)$(l)Accessory$(): Silencing Quartz Pendant, which wards this affix off.
$(l)Dropped material$()$(br2)$(o)Quartz that slowly drinks in magic and lets it fade.$()
Non-physical Resistance covers all non-physical damage, including magic, fire, explosions and environmental damage.
